content.title: About
content.content: Reduced‑sodium crackers matzo are crisp, unleavened flatbreads made from whole‑grain wheat with a lower amount of added salt. They are suitable for Passover, low‑sodium diets, and anyone watching their salt intake.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: Matzo is a traditional staple in Jewish cuisine during Passover.
Reduced sodium is achieved by using a micro‑salt blend and decreasing overall salt quantity.
The product is yeast‑free, making it appropriate for yeast‑free diets.
Low moisture content gives the crackers a long shelf life.
Unlike regular crackers, matzo has a milder flavor that pairs well with many toppings.

items.title: Low sodium content
items.content: Reduced salt helps control blood pressure and lessens kidney workload.

items.title: Source of complex carbs
items.content: Whole‑grain wheat provides steady energy release and promotes satiety.

items.title: High in dietary fiber
items.content: Fiber supports healthy digestion and gut microbiota.

items.title: Low in calories
items.content: Minimal added fat makes the product suitable for calorie‑controlled diets.

items.title: Gluten‑free option available
items.content: A gluten‑free version is offered for those with celiac disease or gluten sensitivity.

items.title: Wheat allergy
items.content: Contains wheat, which may trigger allergic reactions in sensitive individuals.

items.title: Gluten content
items.content: The standard product contains gluten and is not suitable for people with celiac disease.

items.title: Dry texture
items.content: Because of low moisture, the crackers can be very dry; pair them with dips or spreads for better palatability.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Enjoy the crackers as a snack, as a base for open‑face sandwiches, topped with hummus, cream cheese, or avocado. They can also be crumbled into salads and soups for added crunch.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Store in a cool, dry place in an airtight package. For extended storage, keep refrigerated to maintain crispness.
